profile.name: Bode 100频率响应分析仪
profile.description: 这是一台用于扫频测试的频率响应分析仪，可向被测电路注入测试信号并测量增益与相位随频率的变化。实验中常用于滤波器、放大器及控制环路的频率响应表征与传递函数测量。
profile.description_en: This is a swept-frequency response analyzer that injects a test signal into a device under test and measures gain and phase versus frequency. It is commonly used in the lab for frequency-response characterization and transfer-function measurement of filters, amplifiers, and control loops.
